root_cause_clusters.actual: Original PNGs show disabled send filled substantially paler than the opaque disabledFill declaration. Unavailable option text/surface/border are attenuated as a complete row. Enabled send and summary surface remain their intended solid colors.
root_cause_clusters.cause_hypothesis: PlainButtonStyle applies inherited disabled visual attenuation to the custom-painted full label. The source already chooses disabled colors, so a second system dimming pass changes the intended result.
root_cause_clusters.minimal_fix: Use a private ButtonStyle returning the custom label without additional disabled dimming, retaining actual Button.disabled semantics and explicit palette selection.

other_results.notes: Manual observations establish only title wrapping/hierarchy, option clipping and balance overlap in these original public states. Native pixel F remain F. No current-source runtime pass is claimed after modification.
